scope: Outcome-free current-period tag-presence audit of the fixed financial-table candidate ledger; not original-fact arithmetic or stock-price coverage.
filters: Same accession/current archive period label, standard us-gaap version, USD, empty coreg and segments, nonempty source amount field. No amounts retained or used in ratios.
missing_financial_archive_pairs: Report as unassessed, not zero financial facts.
limitations: Archive labels/quarter counts are not exact original intervals.
Original extraction can contain facts absent from flat tables.
Presence does not establish values, duplicate agreement, comparables, identity, vintage or availability.
